subject: Runtime fix: make Persona & Identity iQube drawers open as fast as Wallet/Cartridge

context.not_this_repo: lovable-metame thin-client shell — shell side is correct, do not modify
context.symptom: OPEN_PERSONA_IQUBE and OPEN_IDENTITY_IQUBE drawers open very slowly or not at all; Wallet & Cartridge are near-instant
context.shell_behavior_confirmed: Shell triple-dispatches both messages (canonical envelope, hybrid, flat) immediately on click — verified working

root_cause: OPEN_PERSONA_IQUBE / OPEN_IDENTITY_IQUBE handlers are bound late (inside drawer component useEffects) — early shell messages are dropped
No prompt-intent fast-path for persona/identity in the runtime router (Wallet has one, which is why it feels instant)
RUNTIME_READY is not reliably emitted in production sessions, so any shell-side replay-on-ready logic never fires

required_changes.title: Bind OPEN_PERSONA_IQUBE & OPEN_IDENTITY_IQUBE at MetaMeRuntimeClient bootstrap
required_changes.detail: Move handler registration to the same bootstrap point as LAUNCH_CARTRIDGE. Handlers should set a global runtime store flag (personaDrawer.open, personaDrawer.iqubeType, identityDrawer.open). Drawer components read the flag on mount and open themselves if set. Decouples message arrival from component mount order.

required_changes.title: Add 32-entry FIFO inbound message buffer
required_changes.detail: Buffer shell messages received before bootstrap completes; replay through registered handlers once bootstrap finishes.

required_changes.title: Add prompt intents for persona and identity
required_changes.detail: In the runtime prompt router, add intents matching 'open persona', 'qripto persona', 'knyt persona', 'tell me about the * persona' (opens persona drawer with matched iqube_type) and 'identity', 'open identity', 'identity iqube' (opens identity drawer). Mirrors the Wallet intent fast-path.

required_changes.title: Emit RUNTIME_READY reliably
required_changes.detail: Post {type: 'RUNTIME_READY'} to window.parent with targetOrigin '*' once MetaMeRuntimeClient bootstrap completes AND all shell-message handlers (incl. persona/identity) are bound. Once per mount.

required_changes.title: Optional: ack drawer-open messages
required_changes.detail: Post {type: 'DRAWER_OPENED', payload: {drawer: 'persona'|'identity'|'cartridge', id?}} back to the shell. Lets the shell clear its 'Opening…' badge deterministically.

do_not_change: Envelope field requirements — persona uses payload.iqube_type ('knyt'|'qripto'), identity has empty payload, cartridge uses payload.cartridge_id
Do not require shell to wait for RUNTIME_READY before sending — the buffer (change #2) must handle early arrivals

persona_triple_dispatch: { type: 'OPEN_PERSONA_IQUBE', source: 'shell', payload: { iqube_type: 'knyt'|'qripto' }, msg_id, timestamp }
{ type: 'OPEN_PERSONA_IQUBE', iqube_type: 'knyt'|'qripto', payload: { iqube_type }, msg_id, timestamp, source: 'shell' }
shell_envelope_reference.cartridge_reference: { type: 'LAUNCH_CARTRIDGE', source: 'shell', payload: { cartridge_id: 'metame-codex'|'qripto-codex'|'knyt-codex' }, msg_id, timestamp }

verification: Hard reload runtime in iframe; click Persona → KNYT within first 1s of load — drawer opens within ~250ms
DevTools window.postMessage of OPEN_PERSONA_IQUBE always opens drawer regardless of currently mounted components
